protocol.name: serenity_menu_v1
protocol.copyright:
Copyright (C) 2026 Serenity Linux GUI port
Private protocol between the vendored GTK4 shim (client) and serenity-wlroots-host (compositor). It lets a GTK application hand a GMenuModel to WindowServer, which then draws the menu with the very same WindowServer/Menu.cpp that paints native SerenityOS menus.
Not a public protocol. Both sides must be deployed together.
protocol.description:
The compositor already owns every window's screen geometry and a WindowServer IPC connection. This protocol lets a GTK client describe a menu (items, separators, shortcuts, icons, submenus) and have it painted natively by WindowServer instead of rendering it into an xdg_popup surface with a client-side reimplementation of ClassicStylePainter.
Coordinates are in wl_surface-local space; the compositor translates them to the screen coordinates required by WindowServer.popup_menu.

interface.name: serenity_menu_manager_v1
interface.description: A singleton global. If absent, the GTK shim must fall back to drawing the popover itself (the legacy xdg_popup path).

arg.name: surface
arg.summary: anchor surface; null means use the given coordinates as-is

interface.name: serenity_menu_v1
interface.description: Each object maps to one WindowServer menu id. Items are added before popup(); after popup() the compositor owns input and sends events back.

request.name: add_icon

description.summary: attach an ARGB8888 icon to an item

request.description: The fd is a memfd (or any mmap-able fd) holding width*stride bytes. The compositor converts it to Gfx::ShareableBitmap for WindowServer.add_menu_item.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: input serial that triggered the menu

description.summary: destroy the menu and release WS resources
